candidates.source_name: European Payments Council – SCT Inst rulebook and implementation guidelines
candidates.why_relevant: Primary scheme rulebook binding all adhering PSPs including Czech participants; carries hard dated obligations (2025 SCT Inst rulebook v1.1 in force 5 Oct 2025; unstructured address prohibited from 15 Nov 2026; change requests due 31 Dec 2025).

candidates.source_name: European Payments Council – SCT (SEPA Credit Transfer) rulebook page
candidates.why_relevant: The non-instant SCT rulebook and IGs; same structured-address and ISO 20022 migration deadlines apply to CZ PSPs handling EUR SEPA traffic.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Same as SCT Inst: versioned PDF harvest + date extraction.
queries_used: EPC SEPA rulebook 2026 release adherence deadline SCT Inst

candidates.source_name: European Payments Council – Registers of Participants (all EPC schemes)
candidates.why_relevant: Per-scheme registers (SCT, SCT Inst, SDD Core, SDD B2B, SRTP, SPAA, OCT Inst, VOP) let you enumerate which Czech PSPs have adhered to which rulebook and when — a direct, quantifiable read on CZ scheme adoption.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download register export files periodically, filter country=CZ, diff month-over-month for new adherents/withdrawals.
queries_used: EPC register of participants SEPA schemes Czech Republic banks adherence

candidates.source_name: European Payments Council – Adhering to and using the EPC SEPA schemes (adherence process)
candidates.why_relevant: Documents the adherence procedure, cut-off dates and readiness windows a new CZ PSP must meet — the mechanism behind 'adherence deadlines' in this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual/quarterly HTML diff plus capture of adherence-pack PDFs.
queries_used: EPC register of participants SEPA schemes Czech Republic banks adherence

candidates.source_name: European Payments Council – Verification Of Payee (VoP) scheme
candidates.why_relevant: VoP rulebook in force 5 Oct 2025; euro-area PSPs had to comply by 9 Oct 2025 and non-euro-area (i.e. CZ) PSPs by 9 July 2027 for EUR instant payments — a headline dated obligation for Czech banks and their vendors, plus EPC Directory Service opt-out/billing rules.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the VoP hub + EPC Directory Service page; capture rulebook versions and consultation notices.
queries_used: Verification of Payee VoP scheme rulebook EPC 9 October 2025 povinnost české banky

candidates.source_name: European Payments Council – public consultations / document library
candidates.why_relevant: EPC runs formal public consultations on rulebook change requests with fixed submission windows; this is the earliest signal of upcoming dated scheme obligations affecting CZ participants.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the document-library listing filtered to 'public consultation' and 'rulebooks'; extract closing dates.
queries_used: Verification of Payee VoP scheme rulebook EPC 9 October 2025 povinnost české banky

candidates.source_name: ECB / ERPB – Status updates on SCT Inst scheme, QR-code standardisation and VoP
candidates.why_relevant: ERPB meeting documents give scheme-adoption statistics and forward timetables (including non-euro-area readiness) that EPC pages state only in prose; useful for dating obligations and gauging CZ readiness.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest ERPB meeting-document folders after each biannual meeting; parse PDFs.
queries_used: EPC SEPA rulebook 2026 release adherence deadline SCT Inst

candidates.why_relevant: The Czech open-banking API standard issued by ČBA; de-facto binding on CZ banks and TPPs, released in versions (3.0/3.1/4.1/5.0/6.0, v8 referenced) with implementation windows. Core to any vendor building against CZ bank APIs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML diff of the standard page; pair with the GitHub repo for authoritative version tags.
queries_used: Česká bankovní asociace COBS standard API open banking verze

candidates.suggested_collection_method: GitHub API: poll releases/tags/commits; diff OpenAPI specs between versions.

candidates.why_relevant: Independent CZ aggregator tracking which banks expose which API versions and PSD2 readiness; useful cross-check on COBS adoption per institution and on stragglers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the PSD2 status page + news section periodically; treat as secondary evidence needing confirmation against bank developer portals.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the stable PDF URL on a schedule (edition dates ~April/October), archive each edition, diff section text for Europe/CEE-relevant mandates.

negative_findings.description: The Věstník ČNB hub URL advertised in the legislativní základna link list, https://www.cnb.cz/cs/o_cnb/legislativa_vestnik-cnb/, returned HTTP 404 on fetch. Working access appears to be via per-year pages under /cs/legislativa/vestnik-cnb/vestnik-cnb-rocnik-YYYY/ and direct PDF paths under /export/sites/cnb/cs/legislativa/.galleries/Vestnik-CNB/YYYY/.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404 on the hub path; per-year and per-částka URLs recovered from search results instead. Recorded as moved, NOT dead — the Věstník is plainly still being issued (částka 4/2026 dated 18 June 2026 was surfaced).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Věstník is the legally authentic publication channel for úřední sdělení and opatření. A collector built on the stale hub URL would silently miss the entire authentic corpus, so the per-year URL pattern must be the entry point and needs deterministic verification.

negative_findings.description: No open-data API, bulk download, or structured (JSON/XML) endpoint for the ČNB regulatory corpus was found in this pass. Searches surfaced only HTML pages, PDF documents and an RSS index; ČNB's own RSS note explicitly excludes the application-driven sections (Seznamy a evidence, Pravomocná rozhodnutí, Informace zveřejňované emitenty).
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection for this cell must be assumed to be HTML/PDF scraping plus RSS, not API ingestion, until a dedicated open-data pass proves otherwise.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the engineering cost and fragility profile for the whole ČNB cell, and means the three RSS-excluded registers each need bespoke collectors.

negative_findings.description: No single ČNB page was found that consolidates regulatory application dates / compliance deadlines for banks and payment institutions. Deadline information is scattered across the consultation register (comment-period end dates), individual vyhlášky (účinnost), SDAT methodology change notes, the ESA-guidelines comply-or-explain notices (application dates), and the event calendar.
negative_findings.result_summary: A deadline view must be synthesised by the pipeline from at least five separate ČNB sources; it cannot be lifted from one page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadlines are an explicit topic of this run. Assuming a single authoritative deadline page exists would produce a systematically incomplete calendar.

negative_findings.description: 'Opatření obecné povahy' is a generic Czech administrative-law instrument used by many public bodies. Searching it without a ČNB qualifier returns Český telekomunikační úřad, Ministerstvo vnitra land-use measures, and Supreme Administrative Court case law. Similarly 'vyhláška' alone is near-useless. 'Dohledový benchmark', by contrast, is a high-precision ČNB-specific term.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query design for this cell must pin the actor (ČNB / Česká národní banka) or the sector, or rely on the ČNB-unique terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted collection cycles and false-positive sources in any automated query expansion built on these seed terms.

negative_findings.description: The ČNB consultation register (/cs/legislativa/konzultacni-materialy-a-navrhy/) is dominated in volume by draft vyhlášky for commemorative coins and banknotes rather than by financial-regulation drafts; the most recent entry observed (10 February 2026) was a commemorative gold coin.
negative_findings.result_summary: Roughly the majority of recent entries are numismatic. Financial-regulation drafts (bank reporting, PSP incident and fraud reporting, supervision amendments effective January 2026) are present but interleaved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An unfiltered alerting rule on this page will be mostly false positives and will be ignored by analysts; keyword filtering is mandatory at ingestion.

negative_findings.description: ČNB maintains a parallel /en/ site with the same sectoral structure, but the English corpus is a selective subset: only some RS opinions have -EN pages, dohledové benchmarky were found only as Czech PDFs, and the Věstník částky are Czech-only. ČNB itself states the authentic wording is the Czech Sbírka zákonů / Věstník version.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection would miss the authentic legal texts and most supervisory-expectation material. Czech-language collection is structurally mandatory for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Directly validates the run's mandatory-local-language rule and dictates that OCR/NLP for this cell must handle Czech, including diacritics-stripped variants in URLs and filenames.

negative_findings.description: ČNB does not appear to operate a separate 'open public consultations with countdown' register in the style of EBA/ESMA. Consultation-type material is interleaved with draft decrees (including a large volume of commemorative-coin vyhlášky) on the single Konzultační materiály a návrhy page.
negative_findings.result_summary: The index observed is dominated by numismatic decree drafts; substantive prudential/payments drafts are a minority of entries and comment deadlines are expressed inline as free text rather than as a structured field.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector must filter aggressively by subject and parse deadlines from prose; a naive feed will be mostly coin decrees and will miss the structured comment window entirely.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching for ČNB consultations returned mostly EBA/ESMA material rather than ČNB's own; the ČNB EN site carries a supervision news section but no evident English mirror of the konzultační materiály index.
negative_findings.result_summary: English queries surfaced cnb.cz/en/supervision-financial-market/news/ and .../supervisory-official-information-and-benchmarks/ but no EN consultation index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Czech-language monitoring is mandatory for this cell; an English-only pipeline would miss essentially all CZ comment windows.

negative_findings.description: No consolidated, machine-readable ČNB 'supervisory reporting deadline calendar' (ICS/API/JSON) was found for regulated entities. Deadlines are dispersed across the vyhlášky, per-collection SDAT descriptions, and the Harmonogram XLS (which covers ČNB's own publications, not obligors' due dates).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on kalendář sběrů / harmonogram výkaznictví returned narrative pages and an XLS of ČNB publication dates, not an obligor deadline feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The reporting-timetable half of this cell must be reconstructed by the collector from decree text plus SDAT collection descriptions — it cannot simply be ingested.

negative_findings.description: Several candidate URLs were reached only via search-result metadata or a summarising fetch, not confirmed page-by-page in this pass; one mirrored host (cnb.sp.cz.net) appeared in results and looks like a proxy/mirror rather than the canonical cnb.cz origin and should not be collected from.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only https://www.cnb.cz/cs/legislativa/konzultacni-materialy-a-navrhy/ was directly fetched and read in this pass; the rest rest on search-engine evidence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Liveness and canonicality must be settled by the deterministic verification pass; a 403/timeout on cnb.cz should be read as bot defence, not as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: No CZ bank or PSP was found publishing a machine-readable, standardised changelog feed (RSS/JSON) for regulatory-driven T&C or API changes. Air Bank's dated HTML list is the closest to a true changelog; most institutions publish change notices as loose dated PDFs or one-off news items.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in cs and en for bank API release-notes/changelog feeds returned portal landing pages and third-party trackers, not feeds.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must be built on HTML/PDF diffing and filename-date parsing, not feed subscription; effort estimates should assume per-institution custom extractors.

negative_findings.description: Several CZ bank developer portals (MONETA apiportal.moneta.cz, Raiffeisenbank production APIs, Erste sandbox) appear to place specifications and change notices behind TPP registration or licence checks, so change calendars may not be publicly observable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results and portal descriptions repeatedly reference registration/licence prerequisites; MONETA documentation described as not yet published.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bottom-up dating of PSD2 technical deadlines will be systematically incomplete for gated banks; corroboration must lean on integrator commentary and the banks' public client notices.

negative_findings.description: https://www.apiportal.cz/ — the aggregator recommended by the cz-banking-psd2 repo — refused connection during this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: connect ECONNREFUSED on TLS port 443; no HTTP status obtained.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis, not a verdict: the site may be bot-defended or the failure transient. It should be re-tested by the deterministic liveness pass before being deprioritised.

negative_findings.description: No single settled Czech term exists for 'API change calendar' or 'deprecation notice'. Observed variants include 'aktuálně k API', 'ukončení podpory', 'končí zastaralé endpointy', 'přechod na nové verze', 'změny v API'. English-in-Czech ('release notes', 'changelog', 'sandbox', 'developer portál', 'endpoint') is common but inconsistent.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs queries needed multiple phrasings to surface the same class of document; no canonical keyword.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword-based monitoring must use a disjunctive multilingual pattern set, or it will miss deprecation notices at banks using non-standard wording.

negative_findings.description: For the instant-payments regulation (EU) 2024/886, I found the regulation itself and general reporting, plus an indication that UniCredit announced VOP/sazebník changes in connection with instant payments, but did not reach a bank-published notice page that explicitly cites 2024/886 as the reason for a fee-schedule change.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs query on sazebník changes citing 2024/886 returned regulator/EUR-Lex/press sources rather than a bank notice document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core hypothesis — that bank notices cite the exact legal instrument — is plausible and partially evidenced (Air Bank citing SEPA rules) but not yet confirmed for the 2024/886 case; targeted PDF full-text search across bank notice archives is needed.

negative_findings.description: Searches combining Lupa.cz / Seznam Zprávy / iROZHLAS with 'ČNB pokuta bance', 'dohled', 'fintech zpřísnění' returned only cnb.cz pages, not articles from those outlets.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search does not surface these outlets' regulatory articles well; their content appears under-indexed for these query shapes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for these three must go through their own on-site search / RSS rather than general web search, or coverage of them will look thinner than it is.

negative_findings.description: Section URLs for Seznam Zprávy economics (seznamzpravy.cz/sekce/ekonomika-16) and iROZHLAS economics (irozhlas.cz/ekonomika) were inferred from site conventions, not observed in results, and were not fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Homepage domains are well attested; deep section paths are hypotheses.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass should resolve the correct section/RSS paths before these are wired into collection.

negative_findings.description: Hospodářské noviny (hn.cz) and the print edition of Bankovnictví are subscription-gated; Bankovnictví sells predplatne, HN uses a hard paywall.
negative_findings.result_summary: Highest-value Czech regulatory journalism is largely behind paywalls.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A licensed subscription or a Czech media-monitoring service (Anopress/Newton) is likely required for full-text A3 coverage; headline-only monitoring will miss the substance.

negative_findings.description: Investujeme.cz did not appear in any result set for the fintech/payment-regulation queries run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not confirm current activity or regulatory coverage of that outlet in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Should be checked directly rather than assumed live or assumed dead.

negative_findings.description: English-language queries about Czech banking-rule changes were not productive relative to Czech ones; the cell rationale that English CZ coverage is thin and lagging is consistent with what was observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language querying carried essentially all the discovery value in this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any downstream collection design that relies on English feeds will systematically miss Czech regulatory signals.

negative_findings.description: No official, legally binding English-language consolidated corpus of Czech law was found. e-Sbírka publishes Czech only; English texts of banking/payments acts exist only as informative regulator translations of uncertain vintage.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-language searching surfaced regulator translations and commentary, not a state-guaranteed EN corpus.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any EN-driven pipeline will silently lag the binding CZ text; effective dates and deadlines must always be resolved against the Czech version.

negative_findings.description: The e-Sbírka public API and open data were announced as live from 15 January 2024, but multiple sources report the open data is published without proper documentation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Announcement page and MV FOI responses confirm the API exists; no complete schema documentation located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Machine ingestion of the authoritative corpus will require reverse-engineering endpoints and response shapes, and is exposed to unannounced breaking changes.

negative_findings.description: eKLEP (apps.odok.cz/eklep) — the internal legislative library — is explicitly not intended for the public; only VeKLEP content is exposed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Documented as non-public; no public credential path found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Some pre-consultation drafts and internal comment resolutions are invisible until they surface in VeKLEP, capping how early the pipeline can be seen.

negative_findings.description: Webarchiv NK ČR's full holdings are accessible only from terminals inside the National Library; only contractually cleared selective-harvest sites are served online.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed in Webarchiv's own 'O Webarchivu' and FAQ pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The national archive cannot be the automated fallback for rotted regulator URLs; Internet Archive must carry that role, with a known coverage risk for CZ-only pages.

negative_findings.description: e-Sbírka has been publicly reported (Jan 2024) to be missing some recent regulations at launch, and commentary questions its completeness.
negative_findings.result_summary: Press reporting flags missing recent predpisy; not independently verified here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Completeness of the authoritative corpus cannot be assumed; a second corpus (Zákony pro lidi / Esipa) is needed as a reconciliation check.

negative_findings.description: Věstník ČNB is published in full online only from volume 2001 onward; earlier volumes exist in printed form in the ČNB specialist library.
negative_findings.result_summary: Stated on the ČNB Věstník page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline and supervisory-notice series cannot be reconstructed digitally before 2001 without a manual library visit.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated data.gov.cz dataset specifically for ČNB regulatory acts/Věstník was located in this pass; ČNB regulatory publication appears not to be catalogued as open data.
negative_findings.result_summary: Catalogue-level searching surfaced e-Sbírka open data and general legal-framework articles only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Věstník ČNB and ČNB decree pages must be scraped from HTML/PDF; there is no structured feed for the central bank's own instruments.

negative_findings.description: No standalone, separately published ČNB 'thematic review' report series (analogous to ECB/EBA thematic reviews) was located during this pass. Thematic assessment appears to be described inside the supervisory strategy page and reported within the annual Zpráva o výkonu dohledu and the Dohledová úřední sdělení a benchmarky series, rather than as its own publication series with its own index page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'tematické šetření' / 'tematická kontrola' returned the supervisory strategy page and benchmark series, not a dedicated thematic-review index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should not assume a dedicated thematic-review feed exists for CZ; thematic findings must be extracted from the annual supervisory report and the numbered supervisory communications instead.

negative_findings.description: A dedicated ČNB 'úřední deska' (official notice board) page collecting all opatření obecné povahy in one dated feed was not identified. The Czech query for it returned other public bodies' notice boards (SÚJB, Ministry of Interior, municipalities) and the CCyB-specific provision index on cnb.cz.
negative_findings.result_summary: The CCyB provisions are indexed under the macroprudential policy tree; no cross-cutting ČNB notice-board index surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no single notice-board feed exists, monitoring must be per-instrument (CCyB, systemic risk buffer, O-SII, credit indicators) rather than one consolidated legal-acts feed, which raises the risk of missing an instrument added later.

negative_findings.description: The ESRB national-measures database / EBA CCyB rate register entry for the Czech Republic was not directly located in this pass; the search for it returned only ČNB's own pages. The ESRB is referenced by ČNB as an input to its buffer-guide methodology, so an ESRB-side register very likely exists, but I did not reach it and will not assert its URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query returned cnb.cz results exclusively; no esrb.europa.eu or eba.europa.eu URL confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An EU-level register would give cross-country comparability and an independent confirmation channel for CZ buffer rates and effective dates; it remains an open discovery item.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or API endpoint for ČNB supervision or financial-stability news was confirmed. The RSS-oriented Czech query returned no ČNB feed URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: RSS subscription path for cnb.cz news/supervision remains unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absent a confirmed feed, collection must rely on HTML listing polling, which is more brittle and needs change-detection logic.

negative_findings.description: Ministry of Finance content appears under both mfcr.cz and mf.gov.cz, with recent Zpráva o vývoji finančního trhu pages on mf.gov.cz and older ones on mfcr.cz.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both hostnames returned live-looking URLs for the same report series across different years.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Stored MF URLs may silently rot; the collector should normalise/redirect-follow between the two hosts rather than treat an mfcr.cz miss as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: Searched for CZ payment/banking technology vendors (Trask, Comarch, Asseco, Sonet, MONET+, Profinit) running Czech-language RegTech webinars that name upcoming CZ obligations (e.g. Verification of Payee, SEPA Instant deadlines).
negative_findings.result_summary: No CZ-vendor webinar landing pages surfaced in search; results were dominated by non-CZ webinar platforms (Banking Exchange, RedCompass Labs). Vendor webinar pages appear to live behind marketing sites or LinkedIn events that general search does not index well.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor readiness webinars are the most deadline-explicit part of this cell's rationale; missing them weakens the 'vendors advertise deadlines to sell readiness' signal.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to locate structured CZ banking compliance job-ad results naming specific regulations (PSD3, DORA, MiCA, VoP) on jobs.cz and LinkedIn via search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only aggregator landing pages and Glassdoor/Indeed roll-ups were retrievable; individual ad text naming regulations was visible mostly in secondary boards. Job boards are query-driven and largely invisible to general web search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The hiring signal must be collected by direct parameterised querying of each board rather than by search-engine discovery, which changes the collection design and the ToS exposure.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a canonical, permanently archived programme for 'Trendy v platebním styku' and CARDFORUM on the organisers' own domains.
negative_findings.result_summary: Trendy programme content was found only via a third-party aggregator page; CARDFORUM programmes appear as year-stamped PDFs under cardforum.cz/data/ with no visible index page. Neither was confirmed as a stable archive.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Multi-year agenda trend analysis may require third-party mirrors and PDF-pattern guessing rather than a reliable archive endpoint.

negative_findings.description: No established Czech-language term surfaced for 'RegTech webinar' as a distinct product category; searches on 'webinář regtech' returned generic regulatory-news articles rather than a webinar channel.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Czech market appears to label these as 'odborný seminář', 'školení' or 'webinář' plus the regulation acronym (DORA, PSD3, AML), not as 'regtech'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for ongoing collection must use obligation acronyms plus generic training nouns; 'regtech' is a low-yield term in Czech and would cause silent under-collection.

negative_findings.description: Several sources were identified only through search-result metadata and not fetched (cardforum.cz root, fintechroadmap.cz, kursy.cz, financnictvi.konference.cz, mfcr.cz events).
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are recorded with confidence scores but liveness was not tested here; any of them could be moved or bot-defended.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream deterministic verification must resolve these; a failure should be treated as a hypothesis (bot defence or move), not as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: The seven ČNB open-data CSV datasets cover banks, exchange offices, consumer-credit providers and credit intermediaries, but NOT payment institutions, e-money institutions, small-scale payment service providers (PSMR) or small-scale e-money issuers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched the Otevřená data page and the payments legislation landing page in cs; found no p_seznam CSV endpoint for platební instituce. Those lists appear reachable only through the JERRS UI or WS JERRS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payments half of the run scope has no free bulk feed; collection must go through WS JERRS (certificate-gated) or careful UI querying, which changes the effort and legal profile of the pipeline.

negative_findings.description: WS JERRS, the only officially sanctioned machine interface to the full register, requires an electronically signed application to jerrsws@cnb.cz and authentication with a commercial qualified certificate (eIdentity, I.CA, Postsignum or an EU trust-list CA).
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed from the ČNB WS JERRS documentation page. No anonymous or API-key tier was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Onboarding lead time and a certificate purchase sit between us and the best data source in this cell; it must be started early rather than discovered at build time.

negative_findings.description: The final-decisions application at abok.cnb.cz was identified only from a link on the ČNB pravomocná rozhodnutí hub; its search interface, query parameters and whether it exposes structured export were not inspected in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not fetched. Treated as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Enforcement decisions are the core of the sanctions half of this cell; the ingestion design cannot be finalised until the application's interface is examined.

negative_findings.description: No single consolidated, machine-readable list of ČNB sanctions across all sectors was found; publication duties are fragmented across at least 11 separate sectoral statutes with differing retention rules (e.g. AML decisions published for 5 years after finality, insurance licence withdrawals within 30 days).
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed by reading the pravomocná rozhodnutí hub, which enumerates the legal bases one by one rather than pointing to a unified register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any enforcement time series we build must reconcile heterogeneous, time-limited publication regimes, or it will understate historical AML sanctions.

negative_findings.description: The Czech word 'seznam' is highly ambiguous — Seznam.cz is the dominant Czech search engine, so queries containing 'seznam' return search-engine and unrelated commercial pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: The first cs query returned a search.seznam.cz result and a logistics academy page among the top hits.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Future automated query generation for this cell should pair 'seznam' with disambiguating tokens ('ČNB', 'regulovaných subjektů', 'JERRS') or scope searches to cnb.cz.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language MF ČR page announcing a concrete PSD3/PSR transposition draft or consultation was located, despite the EU texts reportedly being agreed and published. English-language search returned only international law-firm commentary, and Czech search returned only older payments-act amendments (2012, 2016, 2019, 2021).
negative_findings.result_summary: PSD3/PSR CZ transposition work appears not yet publicly visible on MF channels as of this scouting pass, or it is filed under an omnibus 'změna některých zákonů v oblasti finančního trhu' title that keyword search did not surface.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core early-warning promise is seeing payments statute change months ahead; if the PSD3 vehicle is invisible to keyword search, monitoring must be structural (poll all MF-authored VeKLEP materials) rather than keyword-driven.

negative_findings.description: No documented public API or open-data dump for VeKLEP/eKLEP legislative materials was found; open-data/API documentation located covers e-Sbírka and e-Legislativa (Ministry of Interior), not the ODok comment-procedure system.
negative_findings.result_summary: eKLEP/VeKLEP will likely need HTML scraping keyed on the PID identifier; e-Sbírka has proper APIs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines collection engineering cost and fragility for the single highest-value source in this cell.

negative_findings.description: Czech government sites are mid-migration across parallel domains: mfcr.cz vs mf.gov.cz, apps.odok.cz vs odok.gov.cz, isap.vlada.cz vs isap.gov.cz, vlada.cz vs vlada.gov.cz. Both variants currently appear in search results for the same content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple live aliases per source; URL stability cannot be assumed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Naive liveness checks and stored URLs will rot; the collector should canonicalise to the .gov.cz variants and tolerate redirects rather than marking sources dead.

negative_findings.description: MF ČR, ODok/VeKLEP, PSP.cz, Senát and e-Sbírka publish legislative material essentially only in Czech; no equivalent English legislative pipeline feed was found. English-language searching returned only private law-firm and consultancy commentary.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only monitoring of this cell is not viable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms Czech-language NLP/keyword lists are a hard requirement for A3 coverage rather than a nice-to-have.

negative_findings.description: No candidate URL in this slice was fetched-and-confirmed by this agent; all were derived from search-engine result listings and their titles/snippets.
negative_findings.result_summary: All URLs are provided as hypotheses for the deterministic liveness pass, not as verified endpoints.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents downstream over-trust; ISAP (Lotus Domino) and senat.cz (xqw/xervlet) in particular use fragile URL schemes likely to require session handling.

negative_findings.description: No single official CZ or EU page was found that consolidates 'EU act -> Czech application date' for the payments/digital-finance file. ČNB publishes per-instrument pages, ISAP tracks transposition per CELEX, EUR-Lex holds the article text — but the join has to be constructed by the collector.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in cs and en returned per-instrument pages only; no CZ regulatory calendar/timeline artefact surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deliverable of this cell (a CZ-binding deadline timetable) cannot be scraped from one place; it must be assembled from EUR-Lex CS + ČNB sdělení + ISAP, which raises collection cost and makes date-conflict reconciliation a design requirement.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language version of EBA consultation papers or EBA compliance tables was found. EBA consults and publishes compliance tables in English only; only final guidelines get CS translations, and those appear with a lag via ČNB.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs queries for 'EBA konzultace' style terms returned only ČNB sdělení pages and CS PDFs of already-final guidelines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any monitoring confined to Czech-language sources structurally misses the 2-3 month consultation window — the only period in which the eventual CZ obligation can still be influenced or anticipated.

negative_findings.description: The canonical index URLs for (a) the EBA consultation-paper register and (b) the EBA guideline compliance tables were not pinned down in this pass; only the parent Single Rulebook and generic search pages were confirmed in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned Single Rulebook, ISRB and Q&A pages but not a stable consultations/compliance-tables index path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These two are high-value for the cell; a verification pass should resolve them via eba.europa.eu site navigation rather than guessing paths, to avoid recording a fabricated or stale URL.

negative_findings.description: PSD3/PSR has no CELEX identifier or Czech official text yet — reporting indicates provisional political agreement (late 2025) with OJ publication expected during 2026 and application roughly 18-21 months later.
negative_findings.result_summary: All PSD3/PSR timeline detail found was secondary (law firms, Worldline), not primary EU text.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Every PSD3/PSR date currently in circulation is provisional. The source plan must include a trigger that switches from commentary to EUR-Lex CS the day the OJ publication appears, or the intelligence product will carry unsourced dates.

negative_findings.description: The Czech-language ČNB CERTIS instant-payments URL slug was not directly confirmed; only the English mirror (/en/payments/certis/instant-payments/) appeared in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: EN pages confirmed; CS equivalent inferred from ČNB's consistent cs/en mirroring but not observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recorded as inferred, not verified — the liveness pass should resolve the cs slug from ČNB navigation.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or API endpoint for FAÚ aktuality, metodické pokyny or sanctions notices was located during this pass. MZV's sanctions-list section does expose an .rss URL, but nothing equivalent was found on fau.gov.cz.
negative_findings.result_summary: FAÚ change-detection will likely require HTML/PDF diffing rather than feed subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline tracking for obliged entities depends on catching FAÚ notices quickly; without a feed the collector needs frequent polling and robust PDF hashing.

negative_findings.description: No public FAÚ register of individual inspection outcomes, sanctions decisions or fines against named obliged entities was found; enforcement appears to be disclosed only in aggregate via the annual report, and MP numbering shows gaps (no MP č. 2 or č. 10 listed on the current index).
negative_findings.result_summary: Entity-level AML enforcement history for Czech banks and payment institutions is not directly obtainable from FAÚ.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Enforcement-pressure analysis must rely on aggregate statistics plus indirect legal-press reporting; entity-level attribution should not be promised.

negative_findings.description: MoneyWeb, the primary secure STR submission channel, is accessible only after a cooperation agreement and VPN tunnel with FAÚ; MoneyWeb Lite is a distributed desktop client.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the public documentation of the reporting channel is collectable, not the channel itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any claim about reporting formats/schemas must be sourced from public documentation; do not attempt access to the application.

negative_findings.description: The Czech central inter-ministerial comment procedure portal for draft AML legislation (ODOK / VeKLEP, eklep.vlada.cz) was referenced in the seed query but was not directly located or fetched in this pass; the AMLZ amendment drafts were only observed via MF pages and secondary legal commentary.
negative_findings.result_summary: The authoritative CZ pre-legislative consultation venue for AML bills remains unconfirmed for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consultations are an explicit run topic; missing the eKLEP/VeKLEP and Poslanecká sněmovna (psp.cz) bill-tracking layer would lose the earliest visibility on new AML obligations.

negative_findings.description: No Czech industry-side AML source (Česká bankovní asociace AML commission outputs, Czech Fintech Association, or a compliance-officer professional body) was confirmed with a specific working URL in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: The industry-response side of the FAÚ regulation stream is currently unmapped in this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Industry commentary on draft guidance often reveals implementation cost and timing friction that neither FAÚ nor ČNB publishes.

negative_findings.description: The ÚOHS 'Platební styk' page (fetched) describes the IFR supervisory mandate but links no dedicated register of payment-systems decisions, methodologies or press releases; the only 'sborníky rozhodnutí' page located sits under the public-procurement methodology branch.
negative_findings.result_summary: No confirmed URL for an ÚOHS competition/payments decision search interface was found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a decision register, interchange/card enforcement can only be tracked via press releases, which under-report settled or minor cases.

negative_findings.description: The ÚOOÚ banking-sector inspection pages surfaced were from 2005, 2006 and 2016 cycles; no recent (2023-2026) bank- or PSP-specific ÚOOÚ inspection or fine page was confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recent banking-sector GDPR enforcement items exist in aggregate statistics (annual report) but were not located as individual sectoral pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Current enforcement intensity against banks is the actionable signal; only historical sectoral pages were confirmed.

negative_findings.description: ČOI appears under both coi.cz and coi.gov.cz, and Kancelář finančního arbitra under both finarbitr.cz and finarbitr.gov.cz; a test/staging mirror (coi-test.bzcompany.cz) also appears in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical domain not conclusively determined; no liveness claim made.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection pipelines could duplicate or point at a non-canonical/staging host if the domain is not pinned during verification.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom, API or open-data endpoint was confirmed for ÚOOÚ, NÚKIB, ÚOHS or ČOI publication streams in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection will likely require HTML crawling and PDF extraction rather than feeds.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects pipeline cost and change-detection reliability for deadline tracking.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching surfaces mainly advisory commentary; the authoritative material (ZKB 264/2025 Sb., vyhláška 408/2025 Sb., inspection protocols, arbitrator nálezy) is Czech-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection would miss essentially all primary content in this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms cs-language crawling and NLP must be first-class in the pipeline for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Neither cbaonline.cz nor its /en mirror exposed a browsable 'Stanoviska' / 'Připomínky' / 'Position papers' section in the navigation returned by fetching the homepage, /o-nas and /bankovni-regulace. Regulatory commentary appears to be dispersed across news articles, press releases and the codes-and-standards library instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: ČBA's formal consultation responses are not published as a discrete, indexed collection on its own site — unlike ČLFA (/pro-odbornou-verejnost/stanoviska-clfa) and AKAT (/Dokumenty/Dokumenty-AKAT).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A3 collection for ČBA cannot rely on a positions index; it must be assembled from ODOK vypořádání tables, EBA/EC consultation archives and press releases. Plan for a heavier, multi-source pipeline for the single most important association in the cell.

negative_findings.description: https://www.czech-ba.cz/cs returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated fetch, despite ČNB citing czech-ba.cz as ČBA's official URL and search results surfacing live-looking subpages (/en/about-cba, /cs/o-cba/komise-pracovni-organy).
negative_findings.result_summary: Bot defence hypothesis, not a dead site. Not recorded as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If czech-ba.cz holds archived ČBA documents that cbaonline.cz dropped, an automated crawler will silently miss them. Requires browser-based or Wayback-based collection.

negative_findings.description: https://www.cbaonline.cz/kodexy-a-standardy served a 'Page not found' page while https://cbaonline.cz/kodexy-a-standardy is indexed and live; conversely /o-nas/komise-pracovni-skupiny surfaced under the www host.
negative_findings.result_summary: www vs non-www routing on cbaonline.cz is inconsistent per path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A crawler normalising to one host form will generate false 404s and could wrongly mark ČBA sections dead. Canonicalisation must be tested per path, and a 404 on one host must trigger a retry on the other before any liveness verdict.

negative_findings.description: The ČLFA stanoviska page's visible items span 2015-2021, most recent being a joint memorandum on CCD dated 3 December 2021 — yet ČLFA was demonstrably active on the CCD2 consumer credit amendment in March 2026 via press releases.
negative_findings.result_summary: The formal positions library lags the association's actual advocacy by years; current positions are being issued as press releases instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring only the stanoviska section would produce a false 'ČLFA inactive' signal. Press releases (/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy) must be the primary ČLFA channel, with stanoviska as the archive.

negative_findings.description: Czech FinTech Association (ČEFTAS): searches in both cs and en for consultation responses or position papers on PSD3/PSR returned no association-authored position document. Its own site navigation shows only Home / About / Projects / Members / Contact / Membership plus articles, a podcast and a newsletter.
negative_findings.result_summary: ČEFTAS advocacy appears to be conducted informally (direct dialogue with MF ČR/ČNB) rather than through published stanoviska.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For fintech-side regulatory positions, expect to rely on podcast/newsletter/article content, member law firms (e.g. FINREG PARTNERS, ARROWS) and MF ČR consultation summaries rather than association documents.

negative_findings.description: SBK operates a private member portal at data.bankovnikarty.cz/secure/private.htm; ČLFA has a /pro-cleny area. Member circulars — explicitly part of this cell's brief — appear to live behind these gates.
negative_findings.result_summary: Member circulars are not publicly accessible for SBK or ČLFA; no attempt was made to access gated areas.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'member circulars' element of the cell is structurally uncollectable from open sources. It must be substituted by press releases, seminar agendas and ODOK comment tables, or obtained through legitimate membership/subscription.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language term was found for a formal 'consultation response' artefact type published by ČBA; the domestic vocabulary is 'připomínky' / 'vypořádání připomínek' (comments in the inter-ministerial procedure) rather than the EU-style 'stanovisko ke konzultaci'. 'Stanovisko' in CZ financial-market usage most often denotes a ČNB supervisory opinion, not an industry position.
negative_findings.result_summary: Term ambiguity: 'stanovisko' is a noisy query term that returns ČNB supervisory opinions rather than association positions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for this cell must prefer 'připomínky', 'připomínkové řízení', 'vypořádání připomínek', 'memorandum', 'pozice' over 'stanovisko' when targeting associations, and reserve 'stanovisko' for ČLFA/AKAT where it is their own section label.

negative_findings.description: No association in this cell was found to publish a dedicated REGULATORY DEADLINE calendar (transposition dates, effective dates, consultation closing dates). ČBA and AKAT publish event calendars only; SBK publishes conference/seminar announcements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Event calendars exist (cbaonline.cz/o-nas/kalendar, akatcr.cz/Dokumenty/Kalendar-udalosti); regulatory deadline calendars do not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'regulatory event calendar' element of the cell brief must be constructed by inference from event titles plus ODOK/MF ČR milestones, not harvested ready-made.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, recurring KPMG Czech Republic 'FS Regulatory Update' series was found, in either cs or en. KPMG Germany runs exactly such a subscription newsletter (kpmg.com/de .../abo-kpmg-fs-regulatory-update.html), which suggests the format exists in the network but was not located for CZ.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only a general KPMG CZ banking industry hub (kpmg.com/cz/cs/odvetvi/bankovnictvi.html) was identified; no dated regulatory-update series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: KPMG is one of the four named Big Four targets for this cell; without a periodic series its CZ coverage must be collected opportunistically, and EY/Deloitte carry the periodic load.

negative_findings.description: For A&O Shearman, Clifford Chance, White & Case, Dentons and Bird & Bird Prague, no Czech-jurisdiction regulatory client-alert stream was located — only office/practice/people pages and transaction press releases.
negative_findings.result_summary: International firms in Prague appear to publish regulatory content at group level (EU/global), not as CZ-tagged alerts discoverable via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'local trigger date stated plainly' value proposition of this cell comes mainly from domestic firms and Big Four CZ, not from the international offices; collection design should weight accordingly.

negative_findings.description: No RSS feed, Atom feed, or machine-readable subscription endpoint was confirmed for any source in this cell. Email newsletter subscription is referenced by Deloitte CZ and HAVEL & PARTNERS but the mechanics (form URL, archive availability) were not verified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Push-delivery channels are advertised but unverified; all collection designs above assume HTML crawling.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Adviser alerts are time-critical; if RSS/email archives exist, they would cut latency and crawl cost substantially. Worth a dedicated feed-discovery pass.

negative_findings.description: The Deloitte CZ 'Regulatorní novinky' page redirected (302) from www2.deloitte.com to www.deloitte.com, and the redirect target returned 404 on a single fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a domain-migration artefact (content likely relocated under /cz-sk/), not as a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recording it dead would drop one of the two periodic Big Four CZ regulatory digests; the deterministic verification pass must resolve the correct canonical path.

negative_findings.description: No Czech adviser was found publishing a structured, machine-readable regulatory deadline tracker (table/calendar of obligation dates) as a standing free product; deadlines appear embedded in prose alerts, PDFs, and seminar agendas.
negative_findings.result_summary: Closest artefacts are the Lexology 'What's on the horizon for 2026?' format and Pierstone's DORA obligations PDF.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline extraction will have to be NLP-over-prose rather than structured ingestion; budget for that in the collection design.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searching for Visa/Mastercard scheme mandates aimed at CZ acquirers ('mandát', 'pravidla schémat', 'compliance termín') returned no Czech-language scheme-issued rule source. The schemes publish rules only in English; the visa.cz page is a thin consumer-facing pointer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only English scheme rulebooks (visa-rules-public.pdf, mastercard-rules.pdf) and CZ acquirer merchant manuals surfaced; no CZ-language card-scheme rulebook exists as far as the search showed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Card-scheme deadlines affecting CZ actors must be tracked in English at source and cross-read against CZ acquirer manuals; a Czech-only monitoring strategy would miss them entirely.

negative_findings.description: No public, CZ-specific compilation of card-scheme mandate calendars (Visa/Mastercard release deadlines as they apply to Czech acquirers/merchants) was found. Trade-press and consultancy blogs (decta, cardcorp, beastinsights) discuss 2026 VAMP and Mastercard scam-merchant rules generically, not for CZ.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only vendor/consultancy commentary, no CZ-scoped mandate calendar.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a real coverage hole: the deadline calendar must be reconstructed from the global rulebook editions plus acquirer bulletins rather than read off a ready list.

negative_findings.description: The Bank iD developer portal (technical specification, sandbox, API changelog) is referenced repeatedly as the place where the binding technical documentation lives, but it appears to sit behind registration; no unauthenticated URL for the spec was confirmed during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public site describes the developer portal; the portal itself was not reached or verified in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The dated technical obligations for Bank iD integrators may only be observable to registered partners, limiting automated collection to the public contractual annexes.

negative_findings.description: COBS version numbering is reported inconsistently across secondary sources (versions 3.0/3.1/4.1/5.0/6.0 documented, with 'version 8' mentioned in discussion). The authoritative current version was not confirmed from the ČBA page or the GitHub repo in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Conflicting version claims in aggregator/secondary sources; primary confirmation deferred.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline tracking for COBS must be anchored on the GitHub releases/tags rather than on ČBA prose or third-party summaries.

coverage_gaps.description: Several entry points in this slice were inferred from confirmed child URLs rather than fetched directly: the Věstník year-index hub, the informační povinnosti parent hub, and the ČNB kalendář parent. The dohledový benchmark PDF path pattern was likewise generalised from four observed files.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass over every URL in this slice, and specifically resolve the Věstník hub, the informační povinnosti parent, and the kalendář parent before any collector is built on them.

coverage_gaps.description: ČNB is the rule-maker for implementing acts, but primary statutes (zákon o bankách 21/1992 Sb., zákon o platebním styku 370/2017 Sb., zákon o ČNB 6/1993 Sb.) originate with Ministerstvo financí / Ministerstvo spravedlnosti and are authentically published in the Sbírka zákonů (e-Sbírka / Zákony pro lidi). This cell deliberately does not cover them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure a sibling cell covers e-Sbírka / Sbírka zákonů, MF ČR legislative plans, and the ODok/VeKLEP inter-ministerial comment portal, so the ČNB cell's implementing acts can be joined to their enabling statutes.

coverage_gaps.description: A large share of what binds CZ banks and PSPs originates at EBA/ESMA/EIOPA, the ECB/SSM and the EU institutions; ČNB's role is often to declare compliance and set application dates. This slice captures only the ČNB-side transmission notices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with an EU-layer cell (EBA single rulebook and Q&A, ESMA, EUR-Lex, DORA/MiCA/PSD3-PSR files) and join on the guideline identifiers cited in the ČNB sdělení pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Year-index pages for Věstník ČNB were confirmed as far back as 1998, but the completeness, format consistency, and OCR-readability of older částky (scanned vs digital-native PDFs) were not tested in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample one částka each from roughly 1998, 2005, 2015 and 2026 to establish where digital-native text begins and whether OCR is needed for the earlier archive.

coverage_gaps.description: A definitive inventory of the ČNB soft-law instrument types was not completed. Confirmed: vyhláška, opatření obecné povahy, úřední sdělení, dohledový benchmark, stanovisko (RS series), sdělení o obecných pokynech. Not yet confirmed as separate tracked families: 'otázky a odpovědi' / FAQ pages, metodické listy, and dohledové priority statements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do a dedicated enumeration pass over the ČNB supervision chapter to close the instrument-type taxonomy, so the classifier used at ingestion has a complete label set.

coverage_gaps.description: ČNB's robots.txt, terms of use, and any stated reuse/licensing conditions for its published documents were not read in this pass. Collection permissibility was assumed from the public-sector, mandatory-publication character of the material.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read https://www.cnb.cz/robots.txt and the site's podmínky užití before scheduling any high-rate crawl, and set a conservative crawl rate and identifying user agent regardless.

coverage_gaps.description: Parliamentary and Sbírka-zákonů stages were not scouted in this pass: PSP ČR sněmovní tisky, Senát, and the e-Sbírka / Sbírka zákonů a mezinárodních smluv, which carry the definitive effective dates and transitional provisions once a consultation closes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add psp.gov.cz sněmovní tisky search, senat.cz, and e-sbirka.cz as candidates and map the pipeline stage of each document (consultation -> ODok -> government -> parliament -> Sbírka -> účinnost).

coverage_gaps.description: Exact RSS/Atom endpoint URLs behind the ČNB RSS directory were not enumerated, so the cheapest low-latency ingest path is described but not yet concretely specified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.cnb.cz/cs/obecne/rss/index.html and record each feed URL, its section, and whether a supervision-specific or legislation-specific feed exists.

coverage_gaps.description: AML/CFT (FAÚ – Finanční analytický úřad) and cyber/operational-resilience (NÚKIB, ZKB implementing decrees, DORA) consultation and deadline streams touch banks and payment firms but sit outside ČNB and were only glimpsed via a NÚKIB result.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout financnianalytickyurad.cz and nukib.gov.cz consultation/implementation-deadline pages as adjacent candidates for this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/decay strategy was established for closed consultations — ČNB and MF pages reorganise and consultation deadlines decay fast, so historic comment windows and their vypořádání may vanish from the live index.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot each consultation entry on first sighting (HTML + PDFs) and register Wayback captures; keep an internal closed-consultation archive keyed by document title and deadline.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payment institutions and electronic money institutions (platební instituce / instituce elektronických peněz) are under-covered relative to banks. Only GoPay, Comgate and Citfin were reached; the full ČNB-licensed population was not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the ČNB 'Seznamy a evidence' register of platební instituce and instituce elektronických peněz, then apply the bank-side monitoring recipe (dated T&C PDFs + 'oznámení o změně' news detector) to each entity's site.

coverage_gaps.description: Client-facing 'Oznámení' documents (KB-style 'Oznámení o provádění platebního styku', cut-off times, payment-execution notices) were only touched incidentally, yet they are where operational effects of payments law land.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over each major bank's 'Oznámení' document family, capturing effective dates and diffing execution/cut-off terms.

coverage_gaps.description: Regulatory themes beyond PSD2/SEPA/instant payments — DORA operational-resilience notices, AML/KYC client-information updates, and PSD3/PSR readiness statements — were not surfaced from regulated-entity publishers in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up cs+en query set using 'DORA', 'provozní odolnost', 'AML aktualizace údajů klienta', 'PSD3', 'nařízení o platebních službách' scoped to bank and PSP domains.

coverage_gaps.description: T&C and API notices are typically replaced in place; historical versions (needed to date when a rule actually arrived) are often not retained by the publisher.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish snapshotting from day one (own store plus Wayback save-page-now on each observed URL) so effective-date series can be reconstructed later.

coverage_gaps.description: Several portal URLs in this slice come from a community index that self-describes updates as sporadic (e.g. Equa bank and Sberbank CZ entries reference institutions that have since merged or exited the CZ market).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Reconcile every portal URL against the ČNB list of licensed banks before adding to the monitoring set; drop or redirect defunct entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Broadcast and public-service TV coverage (ČT24 / Události v regionech, ceskatelevize.cz) and the ČTK wire (ceskenoviny.cz) were not scouted in this pass, though both carry same-day regulatory news.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout ct24.ceskatelevize.cz and ceskenoviny.cz/ČTK economics feeds, plus Deník N and Aktuálně.cz, as additional Czech-language desks.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/full-text route identified for paywalled Czech business press.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate Anopress IT or NEWTON Media licensing, or institutional access, for retrospective full-text search of HN, Ekonom, E15 and Bankovnictví.

coverage_gaps.description: Consultation-stage coverage (připomínkové řízení, veřejná konzultace) is thinly represented among media sources; media mostly report after drafts are public.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this media cell with the MF ČR / ODok eKLEP consultation trackers so media criticism can be joined to the actual consultation document and its deadline.

coverage_gaps.description: No source in this slice was fetched directly; all evidence is from search-result metadata and snippets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/RSS-discovery pass over every URL here before ingestion, and record HTTP status plus feed URL.

coverage_gaps.description: The concrete e-Sbírka API base URL, endpoint list and bulk-download distribution URLs were not pinned down in this pass — only the announcement page and the operator were identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch zakony.gov.cz open-data page and the MV opendata API description directly, then register concrete endpoints; file a FOI (žádost dle zák. 106/1999 Sb.) for the API spec if documentation is still missing.

coverage_gaps.description: This slice covers the government (ODok/VeKLEP) and Chamber of Deputies stages but did not map Senát PČR document/open-data channels, which carry a distinct set of deadlines.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout senat.cz senátní tisky and any bulk data offering; join by Sbírka number to complete the end-to-end legislative timeline.

coverage_gaps.description: EUR-Lex / EU Official Journal Czech-language corpus and the CZ transposition notification records (which drive most CZ banking/payments deadlines) were out of scope of this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an EUR-Lex CZ cell using the Cellar SPARQL/REST API and the national transposition measures (NIM) records for CRD/PSD/AMLD files.

coverage_gaps.description: Paywalled professional corpora (ASPI/Wolters Kluwer, Beck-online, CODEXIS) were not assessed; they carry richer amendment metadata and commentary but under restrictive licences.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess licence terms and whether an existing organisational subscription permits programmatic use; otherwise record as reference-only.

coverage_gaps.description: No baseline inventory yet exists of which ČNB/MF/Vláda legacy URLs (cnb.cz, mfcr.cz, vlada.cz, odok.cz) have already migrated to .gov.cz and which redirect versus 404.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a one-off crawl of known legacy paths recording status codes and redirect targets, and store an Internet Archive CDX snapshot reference for each, before more links rot.

coverage_gaps.description: The Collection of International Treaties (Sbírka mezinárodních smluv) strand within e-Sbírka was not separately examined, though it matters for cross-border supervisory arrangements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check whether the e-Sbírka API exposes treaties as a distinct series and whether effective-date semantics differ.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level reciprocity and buffer registers (ESRB national measures database, EBA CCyB register, ESRB recommendations on reciprocation) were not pinned down, so the cell currently has only the national side of dated macroprudential obligations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on esrb.europa.eu and eba.europa.eu for the CZ country entry and for the ESRB reciprocation recommendation list; link them to the ČNB reciprocita page.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage skews to banking/credit. Payments-specific supervisory outputs (payment institutions, e-money institutions, PSD2/PSD3-related supervisory expectations, DORA oversight) were not separately enumerated even though the run scope is sector=both.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Follow the ČNB 'Výkon dohledu' sector navigation into platební instituce / instituce elektronických peněz and enumerate their supervisory outputs and any sector-specific dohledová sdělení.

coverage_gaps.description: The depth of the online archive for the supervisory report and for the opatření obecné povahy series was inferred from search results, not enumerated. Earliest available year and any gaps are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the archive listings page by page and, where years are missing, check a web archive before concluding a gap is real.

coverage_gaps.description: English mirrors clearly exist for the CCyB provisions, financial stability reports and Bank Board decisions, but parity was not confirmed for the Dohledová úřední sdělení a benchmarky series or the supervisory strategy page — these may be Czech-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check each series' /en/ counterpart; where absent, plan for cs-only ingestion plus machine translation, and record cs as the authoritative text.

coverage_gaps.description: Sanction and enforcement decision outputs (pravomocná rozhodnutí, sankční řízení) are referenced from the Výkon dohledu hub via a dedicated application but were not enumerated as a source in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and register the ČNB binding-decisions search application as a separate candidate; it is a distinct supervisory-output series with its own access pattern.

coverage_gaps.description: Individual CZ bank and PSP career portals (ČSOB, Komerční banka, Česká spořitelna, Raiffeisenbank, MONETA, Air Bank, Fio, ČSOB PS, Comgate, ThePay, Global Payments CZ) were not enumerated; only one bank career page was captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit registry of CZ bank/PSP career-page URLs from the ČNB list of licensed institutions and add each as a monitored hiring-signal source.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn (company pages, LinkedIn Events, and posts by CZ compliance officers and RegTech vendors) is the most active informal channel for seminar/webinar announcements but was not collected due to access and ToS constraints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a compliant LinkedIn approach (official API, manual analyst review, or partner tooling) for a watchlist of ~30 CZ banking/fintech/vendor pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak-language material was not searched, although the flagship payments conference is explicitly ČR & SR and many CZ obligations are discussed jointly with SK counterparts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sk-language queries (platobný styk, seminár, regulácia) as a secondary channel where CZ/SK events share agendas.

coverage_gaps.description: No source yet captured for training/certification bodies in AML and payments (e.g. ICT/AML certification providers, Czech Institute of Internal Auditors, ACAMS CZ chapter) whose curriculum changes track new obligations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated cs search pass on 'certifikace AML', 'Český institut interních auditorů seminář', 'ACAMS Praha' and add qualifying bodies.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured way yet to convert agenda/job-ad text into a dated obligation register; sources are catalogued but the deadline-extraction method is unspecified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Specify an extraction schema (obligation name, claimed effective date, claimant, evidence URL, date observed) so indirect deadline claims can be tracked and later reconciled against official ČNB/EU sources.

coverage_gaps.description: The JERRS web application's query URL structure (roles, list codes, pagination, export options) was not mapped; only the login/entry URLs are known.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do a hands-on browser session against apl.cnb.cz/apljerrsdad to map role codes and any CSV/print export, and record the parameter grammar for the collector.

coverage_gaps.description: Passporting notifications — foreign payment institutions, e-money institutions and banks notified to operate in CZ under freedom of services/establishment, and CZ entities passporting out — were not located as a distinct ČNB list in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search cs terms 'notifikace', 'volný pohyb služeb', 'svoboda usazování', 'jednotný evropský pas' on cnb.cz, and cross-check the EBA credit-institutions and payment-institutions registers for CZ.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-ČNB Czech registers that complement the supervisory ones — obchodní rejstřík / justice.cz, ARES, evidence skutečných majitelů (UBO register), and the Finanční analytický úřad (FAÚ) AML side — were out of this cell's scope but are needed to resolve entity identity and ownership behind register entries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign ARES/justice.cz/ESM and FAÚ to another cell, or extend this one, so IČO-keyed enrichment of register entries is possible.

coverage_gaps.description: Register snapshots are current-state only; JERRS does not obviously expose historical states beyond the vznik/zánik query, and open-data CSVs are overwritten.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin our own snapshot archive immediately (versioned storage of every CSV and query result) so a time series exists from run start onward; also check the Internet Archive for past snapshots of the open-data endpoints.

coverage_gaps.description: The English mirror of ČNB pages exists but was only spot-checked; whether the EN site carries the same register links and the same freshness as the CS site is unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Compare the cs and en Seznamy/lists-registers hubs link-by-link once; if EN lags, pin the collector to CS URLs and use EN only for terminology.

coverage_gaps.description: Comment-procedure OUTPUT (vypořádání připomínek — who objected and how MF resolved it) was not located as a separately monitorable feed; it is normally an annex inside the government-meeting material rather than an indexed document.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each tracked PID, harvest the 'vypořádání připomínek' annex from the VeKLEP material at the government-submission stage; this is where ČNB, ČBA and MPO positions become visible.

coverage_gaps.description: Industry comment bodies specific to banking/payments (Česká bankovní asociace, ČLFA, ČNB as připomínkové místo, Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů) were not scouted in this cell — only the cross-sector Hospodářská komora was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a targeted pass on cba.cz / clfa.cz stanoviska and pripomínky to legislative drafts; coordinate with the supervisor-focused cell to avoid duplication.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured alerting mechanism (RSS/Atom/email subscription) was confirmed for any of the primary state sources; monitoring design currently assumes polling.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each domain for /rss, /feed, sitemap.xml and any 'odběr novinek' subscription form during the verification pass; fall back to daily diffing where absent.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed crosswalk between the three identifier systems in this pipeline: eKLEP PID (KORNxxxxxxx), sněmovní tisk number + volební období, and the final Sbírka zákonů number.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and maintain a join table per bill; MF press releases and the government-meeting outcomes are the practical bridging documents.

coverage_gaps.description: Deposit insurance / resolution (zákon o bankách, Garanční systém finančního trhu), AML (zákon č. 253/2008 Sb., new Finanční analytický úřad package spotted in HK ČR listings) and the 'digitalizace finančního trhu' (DORA/MiCA) vehicle were only touched incidentally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the keyword watchlist beyond 'platební styk' to: zákon o bankách, spořitelní a úvěrní družstva, ozdravné postupy a řešení krize, Finanční analytický úřad, digitalizace finančního trhu, ekonomická ochrana státu.

coverage_gaps.description: ESMA and EIOPA were not scouted in this pass even though they co-issue guidelines that ČNB adopts via the same 'Sdělení ČNB' mechanism (relevant to MiCA on the ESMA side, and to bancassurance distribution).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add esma.europa.eu (MiCA technical standards, Q&A, consultations) and the ESMA registers to the source set; the ČNB obecné pokyny index already covers the CZ-side adoption notices for both.

coverage_gaps.description: EU legislative-process trackers (EP Legislative Observatory / OEIL, Council public register, Interinstitutional file numbers) were not scouted. These carry trilogue documents and adoption dates months before EUR-Lex publication.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout oeil.secure.europarl.europa.eu and consilium.europa.eu public document register for the PSD3/PSR and AMLA files; they are the only primary sources for pre-publication timing.

coverage_gaps.description: Industry scheme-level rulebooks (European Payments Council SCT Inst rulebook, Verification of Payee scheme rules) were not scouted. IPR compliance for CZ banks is executed through EPC scheme deadlines, not only through the Regulation's own dates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add europeanpaymentscouncil.eu rulebook release calendar and the Czech Banking Association (ČBA) position pages as the CZ industry-side mirror.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech-language coverage is strong for national adoption artefacts (ČNB, MF, FAÚ, ISAP) but thin for EU-origin consultation and pre-legislative material, which is English-only in practice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design the collection plan as two-tier: English for upstream (consultations, trilogue, EBA level 2/3), Czech for the binding downstream (EUR-Lex CS, ČNB sdělení, Sbírka zákonů). Do not expect cs coverage upstream.

coverage_gaps.description: The Czech national statute-book layer (Sbírka zákonů / e-Sbírka, zákon č. 31/2025 Sb. and 32/2025 Sb.) was identified only indirectly through ČNB and MF pages, not scouted as a source in its own right.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout e-sbirka.cz / zakonyprolidi.cz as the authoritative CZ text layer where EU regulations are given national sanctioning and effect dates; assign to a CZ-domain cell to avoid duplicating this cell's EU-origin focus.

coverage_gaps.description: Official legislative pipeline sources are not yet pinned: e-Sbírka (esbirka.cz / sbirka.gov.cz) for authoritative consolidated AMLZ text and effective dates, eKLEP/VeKLEP for inter-ministerial comment procedure on AML bills, and psp.cz for parliamentary passage of AMLZ novely.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated cs pass on 'e-Sbírka zákon 253/2008', 'VeKLEP návrh zákona AML připomínkové řízení', 'psp.cz sněmovní tisk novela AML zákona' and register each as a direct source with concrete URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level sanctions list feeds that Czech obliged entities must screen against (EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List / FSD, EU Sanctions Map, UN Security Council consolidated list) were referenced indirectly via FAÚ 'informační zdroje' but not individually catalogued with verified URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.fau.gov.cz/cs/rozcestnik/mezinarodni-sankce/informacni-zdroje-171 and register each linked EU/UN list feed as its own candidate, noting machine-readable distribution formats.

coverage_gaps.description: Co-supervisors and adjacent AML authorities for specific obliged-entity classes were not covered: Celní správa ČR (gambling sector, co-author of MP č. 6), Česká obchodní inspekce, professional chambers (ČAK for lawyers, notarial and auditor chambers), and the Evidence skutečných majitelů register operated by the courts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a snowball pass on the co-supervision map named in FAÚ annual reports and MP č. 6, capturing each authority's AML guidance page.

coverage_gaps.description: Version history of metodické pokyny is not preserved anywhere obvious: FAÚ replaces PDFs at stable-looking asset paths and different filename patterns coexist (/assets/cs/cmsmedia/... vs /files/...), so silent re-issues can be missed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Hash and archive every guideline PDF at each poll, and cross-check against archiv.financnianalytickyurad.cz and web.archive.org snapshots to reconstruct the obligation timeline.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage on fau.gov.cz is partial and lags the Czech tree (only selected guidelines such as MP č. 9 exist in EN); several sanctions and stanoviska pages appear cs-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat cs as the authoritative language for this cell and use EN only for cross-border comparability; flag any EN-only-derived finding as potentially stale.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed URL for the ÚOOÚ úřední deska (official notice board) or a structured register of its administrative decisions/fines was captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl uoou.gov.cz sitemap for 'uredni-deska' and 'rozhodnuti' paths; confirm whether decisions are published individually or only aggregated in the annual report.

coverage_gaps.description: NÚKIB legislative sub-pages (vyhlášky, metodiky, podpůrné materiály) and the úřední deska were seen only as menu labels, not as confirmed deep URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate nukib.gov.cz/cs/kyberneticka-bezpecnost/* and /cs/uredni-deska/* and pin the decree/methodology index used for deadline tracking.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent actors not yet scouted in this cell: ČTÚ (electronic communications, relevant to SMS/2FA and mobile payments), MPO as ČOI's parent and consumer-law legislator, EDPB/EDPS Czech contributions, and the Sbírka zákonů / e-Sbírka as the authoritative promulgation source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add targeted cs queries for ČTÚ, MPO ochrana spotřebitele, and e-Sbírka (zakonyprolidi/e-sbirka) in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Consumer NGOs that generate conduct pressure and complaint data (dTest, SOS - Asociace beyond its supervisor map) were not individually scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout dtest.cz and asociace-sos.cz complaint/testing outputs relating to banking fees, card payments and credit.

coverage_gaps.description: Authority-level public consultations (ÚOOÚ methodological consultations, NÚKIB draft-decree comment rounds) were only reached indirectly via ODok/VeKLEP; no authority-hosted consultation page was confirmed.
